books.title: The Cards You're Dealt: How to Deal When Life Gets Real (A Tarot Guidebook)
books.author: Theresa Reed
books.description: Theresa shows how to use the tarot as a companion through hard passages of life: a frightening diagnosis, caring for someone, the end of a relationship or job, an empty nest, loss and grief. Drawing on more than thirty years of readings, she offers spreads and guidance for newcomers and professional readers alike, and frames the book as one about living well and making the most of the time we have.
